source.title: Catching Crypto Trends; A Tactical Approach for Bitcoin and Altcoins
source.publication: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 25-80

hypothesis: Diversifying the fixed Donchian ensemble across the 20 most liquid point-in-time eligible crypto assets stabilizes idiosyncratic trend timing and produces net Sharpe above one.
price_interpretation: Binance perpetual OHLC is used as a high-quality price proxy for a spot-like long-only implementation; funding is not charged because the proposed implementation can be executed in spot.
universe: Dynamic daily top 20 by lagged trailing-30-day median quote volume; at least 365 calendar days since first full daily bar; no future-survival requirement.
entry_exit: Same fixed nine-horizon Donchian breakout/trailing-midpoint model as the source, next-day-open execution.
position_sizing: Each selected asset's active-model fraction multiplied by min(2, 25% / lagged 90-day annualized volatility), then divided by 20. No renormalization to active assets.
development_gate: net Sharpe >0.80, positive total return, max drawdown <30%
success_gate: OOS net Sharpe >1.0, positive at 2x costs, 2024 and 2025 each positive, max drawdown <25%, one-day extra delay Sharpe >0.8
limitations: Perp prices proxy spot execution; funding/basis are omitted rather than falsely approximated because the source strategy is long-only and spot-executable.
